meta.title: Rebidding is refused where the seller is barred from it
gaps: No operation or field configures an event to bar rebidding.
The available revision library case tests a tick-size violation and expects code 214, not a rebidding restriction with code 101.
The plan cannot verify that the seller is barred specifically from rebidding.

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The invited QA vendor sends the bid call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with a clear message, and never with a server error.
